turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been waking up with a stiff neck. Is it my pillow?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It could be. A pillow that's too high or too flat for how you sleep can definitely do that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Side sleepers usually need a thicker, firmer pillow to fill the gap between your ear and your shoulder.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've saved up enough to upgrade one part of my gaming setup, and I keep changing my mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All the options first, comments after.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A new graphics card would let me play the latest games on high settings, but it's the priciest.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a really good monitor, bigger and faster, so everything I already play looks smoother.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could also get a proper desk chair, because my back hurts after an evening of playing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And there's a nice wireless headset, which would mean no more tangled cables when I play with friends.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd think about the chair first, since pain makes every session worse. Between the card and the monitor, the monitor is better value unless your current card struggles. The headset can wait for a birthday.
